definitions.local_highland_proxy: dry land Y>=72; local raised-ground proxy, not mountain classification
definitions.local_lowland_proxy: dry land Y<=65; low-elevation proxy only
definitions.ridge_position_proxy: dry land, relief64>=8 and height in upper20% of local 65x65 land-only min/max range; can include scarps, no verified ridge axis

uncertainty: Fixed operational thresholds; no land use, ridge-route or regional boundary inference
